name: Umbrage Prism Atoll
core_rationale: Southern eclipse-shadow crystal atoll of Continent 03 where Vesper's smoky quartz spires split twilight starlight into seven walkable spectrum bridges.
local_conflict: Umbral prism-seraphs and shadow-refraction wisps patrol the crystal spectrum spans.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Star-navigators say that walking the violet band of Umbrage Prism Atoll muffles every footstep into a harp-chord.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Smoky quartz prism-spires rising from a floating basalt ring and projecting seven-colored light bridges across the void.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What eclipse-glass sanctum sits at the focal point of Umbrage Prism Atoll?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-vesper-dream-eater and scar-vesper-crater along the southern eclipse-shadow rim of Continent 03.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Smoky quartz prism-spires splitting twilight starlight into seven walkable spectrum bridges.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Specifies 12.5m crystal spectrum bridges, 0.58m optics tables, and 0.14m quartz risers for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Draft status: awaiting playable leaf map authoring for Violet Spectrum Span and Umbrage Focal Sanctum.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Provides complete mystery_hook and reserves hunting-area-violet-spectrum-span as a Mystery frontier.
